_description: A couple's plan AS SAVED IN 2025 (referenceYear 2025). Importable fixture for the explicit 'Update to current year' feature and for calendar-year compare alignment. Deterministic (0% returns, 0% inflation, zero tax) so every path value is hand-checkable. Includes the things the update must NOT move: a relocation with an absolute startYear (2028), a black-swan year (2027), and a one-time goal at the current age (2025) that falls into the past once the plan is updated.
_rationale: Index 0 = 2025 (age 60, spouse 58); 31 years to age 90. Accounts total $1.5M (Trad 400k + Brokerage 900k + Roth 200k), all 60/40. Path[i] is the beginning-of-year balance; growth (black swan) applies, then the year's net flow. Flows: 2025 consulting +50k (after-tax) vs living 60k + one-time vacation 10k = -20k. 2026 -10k. 2027: black swan stock x0.6 on 60/40 = x0.76 on every account, then -10k. 2028-2031: -60k each. 2032-2033 (self SS 30k at 67): -30k. 2034+ (spouse SS 20k at spouse 67): -10k. Tax is zero throughout: consulting is after-tax; LTCG rate 0 so brokerage pulls are free; SS provisional income (0.5 x SS + brokerage-withdrawal proxy + RMD) never lifts taxable ordinary income above the MFJ standard deduction; Florida->Texas both have no income tax; IRMAA/NIIT disabled. Self RMD starts at 75 (born 1965) in 2040 and is reinvested tax-free, so totals are unaffected. Brokerage never depletes (900k x0.76 less ~560k of pulls).
name: Stale Plan (2025)
